governance: Rules in this file are DRAFT proposals. A rule produces flags only after a user holding the rule_reviewer role approves that exact rule version in the application, recording the reviewer and the reference they checked. Editing a rule requires a new version and a new approval. AI-drafted rules are never auto-activated.

rules.title: Medication requires review: anticoagulant recorded
rules.message: The patient's verified medication list includes an anticoagulant. Review its relevance to the planned procedure.
rules.rationale: Anticoagulants are relevant to bleeding management for invasive dental and surgical procedures.
rules.reference: Scottish Dental Clinical Effectiveness Programme (SDCEP). Management of Dental Patients Taking Anticoagulants or Antiplatelet Drugs, 2nd edition (2022). Reviewer to confirm applicability.

rules.title: Medication requires review: antiplatelet agent recorded
rules.message: The patient's verified medication list includes an antiplatelet agent. Review its relevance to the planned procedure.
rules.rationale: Antiplatelet agents are relevant to bleeding management for invasive dental and surgical procedures.
rules.reference: Scottish Dental Clinical Effectiveness Programme (SDCEP). Management of Dental Patients Taking Anticoagulants or Antiplatelet Drugs, 2nd edition (2022). Reviewer to confirm applicability.

rules.title: Medication requires review: bisphosphonate recorded
rules.message: The patient's verified medication list includes a bisphosphonate. Review its relevance to the planned procedure.
rules.rationale: Bisphosphonate exposure is relevant to risk assessment for procedures involving bone (medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaw).
rules.reference: Scottish Dental Clinical Effectiveness Programme (SDCEP). Oral Health Management of Patients at Risk of Medication-related Osteonecrosis of the Jaw (2017). Reviewer to confirm applicability.

rules.title: Attention: bisphosphonate recorded
rules.message: A bisphosphonate is recorded as current medication. This is a specialty attention prompt only; it does not assert procedure risk.
rules.rationale: Specialty-level attention prompt for orthodontic treatment planning.
rules.reference: To be supplied by the clinical reviewer before approval.
